user.title: SKS sign in
user.description: Enter the login and password of your «Российские коммунальные системы» personal account (lk.roscomsys.ru).

account.title: Select account
account.description: Several personal accounts are bound to this login. Choose which one this entry should track — you can add the integration again for another account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication required
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credentials no longer sign in. Re-enter your «Российские коммунальные системы» login and password.
